core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Halimeh corresponds to the Arabic form حليمة (Arabic root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m); حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma)). Its core sense is patient, forbearing, gentle. Halimeh is the Persian and Turkish rendering of Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma) 'patient, forbearing (feminine)', from the root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m). Same name as haleema, halima and halimah.

faq.a: Halimeh is associated with the Arabic form حليمة, whose core sense is patient, forbearing, gentle.

faq.q: What is the origin of Halimeh?
faq.a: Halimeh is associated with Arabic. Halimeh is the Persian and Turkish rendering of Arabic حَلِيمَة (Ḥalīma) 'patient, forbearing (feminine)', from the root ح ل م (ḥ-l-m). Same name as haleema, halima and halimah.
Yes — the underlying form حليمة is Arabic.
Halimeh can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Halimeh should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Halimeh mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Halimeh is rendered حلیمہ and carries the sense بردبار، حلیم، نرم.

faq.q: What does Halimeh mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Halimeh is rendered حلیمه and carries the sense بردبار، حلیم، نرم.
A romanized syllable approximation is ha-li-meh. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Halimeh?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Halimeh, halimeh. Script forms are حليمة, حلیمه, حلیمہ, हलीमा.

faq.q: Is Halimeh a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
